name: Cascaded Bundle-Adjusting Neural Radiance Fields (CBARF)
definition: A 3D reconstruction framework that optimizes camera poses in a coarse-to-fine manner using cascaded BA modules to progressively improve poses from imperfect inputs, followed by scene reconstruction using a density voxel grid.
summary: CBARF is a 3D reconstruction framework that uses cascaded compact bundle adjustment modules to progressively refine imperfect camera poses and avoid over-fitting, unlike single-stage methods.
